name: C4 diagrams
description: C4 diagrams your agents draw, shown next to their terminal, with click to zoom

tools.name: show
tools.description:
Draw a C4 (or sequence) diagram for the user, next to your terminal. Send Mermaid: a `flowchart` with one `subgraph` per boundary, boxes labelled "Name [Kind]
purpose" (Kind: Person, Software System, Container, Component, Database, Queue, External System), labelled arrows (A -->|reads| B), and `classDef new`/`changed`/`external` with `class a,b new`; or a `sequenceDiagram`. Give each diagram an `item` id ("containers") and send it again with the same item to update it in place: the user sees what changed. Boxes whose Name is a boundary of another diagram you showed open it on click. Bad Mermaid changes nothing and comes back with line and column.

mermaid.description: The diagram's Mermaid source: `flowchart` (or `graph`) or `sequenceDiagram`, with or without a ```mermaid fence

title.description: The diagram's title (else its frontmatter title, else its first box's Name)
